parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter but cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: Permissions
parameters.description: An array of security group rules. You can specify up to 200 IDs of security group rules.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the security group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter but cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). By default, this parameter is empty.
